versions.changelog:
Destructive Command Guard v1.0.0

- Initial release of a Rust-based high-performance command guard hook for Claude Code.
- Blocks destructive git, filesystem, and system commands before execution, protecting against accidental data loss.
- Features a whitelist-first architecture with safe commands always allowed and dangerous patterns blocked.
- Modular "pack" system organizes protections by command category (git, database, cloud, etc.) and supports custom configuration.
- Provides environment variable support for easy customization and bypass.
- Offers clear explanations for blocked commands, sub-millisecond latency, and straightforward installation options.
